title: Sections normalization of lisse point realization
statement: For the normalized realization and point comparison [def-real-lisse-realization-data], require ordinary sections to commute with scalar localization by the map $c\otimes m\mapsto c(1\otimes m)$. Use the recorded integral point sections and rationalization [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension], exact ordinary sections [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact], and the exact scalar localization counit. The derived comparison is the termwise localization of the preceding ordinary map. After the specified size-descent normalization of the recorded point fibre [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], its degree-zero homology map, followed by the inverse integral realization, is required to equal the lisse point comparison.
